title: Necessary for What? Auditing Demographic Disclosure to LLM Synthetic Respondents
abstract: arXiv:2611.20606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly answer surveys on behalf of real panelists, and each panelist's recorded demographic attributes (e.g., age, education, ethnicity) are often placed in the prompt on the premise that richer profiles make more faithful synthetic respondents. While data minimization limits personal data to what a purpose requires, a synthetic survey serves several purposes at once, from predicting individual answers to estimating how opinions are distributed and comparing groups. We ask which of these purposes require the respondent's record, and whether improved estimates support sound conclusions about groups. We vary whose profile a model receives, where it comes from, and how many fields it contains, in two U.S. surveys with eleven open-weight and three hosted models, and compare each model with a statistical model fit to the same information. translated_title: 何为必要？审计向大语言模型合成受访者披露的人口统计信息
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地代表真实面板受访者回答调查问题，而每位受访者的已记录人口统计属性（如年龄、教育程度、种族等）通常被置于提示中，其前提是更丰富的个人档案能造就更忠实的合成受访者。虽然数据最小化原则要求将个人数据限制在特定目的所需的范围内，但合成调查同时服务于多种目的，包括预测个人答案、估计观点分布以及比较不同群体。我们探究这些目的中哪些真正需要受访者的档案记录，以及改进后的估计是否支持关于群体的可靠结论。我们在两项美国调查中，使用十一个开源权重模型和三个托管模型，改变模型接收谁的档案、档案来自何处以及包含多少字段，并将每个模型与基于相同信息拟合的统计模型进行比较。我们做出了四项贡献。首先，我们表明该记录几乎没有增加……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过多模型、多调查的审计实验发现，将面板受访者的详细人口统计档案放入提示中对大多数合成调查目的几乎没有帮助，质疑了“更丰富的个人档案造就更忠实合成受访者”这一普遍前提。
en_tdlr: This study audits demographic disclosure to LLM synthetic respondents across two U.S. surveys and fourteen models, finding that panelists' demographic records add little value for most survey purposes, challenging the premise that richer profiles make more faithful synthetic respondents.
